units.title: Decision gate: which trunk is canonical?
units.intent: Pick the canonical trunk (recommended: cad-fusion-live-ms0); blocks trunk-dependent units.

units.title: Decision gate: keep or delete archive/forge-orphans-2026-05-01
units.intent: Decide whether to keep the 3.09 GB whisper-model archive branch as cold storage or delete it (-3.3 GB).

units.title: Decision gate: do the history rewrite + force-push
units.intent: Decide whether to rewrite history and force-push to unblock cad-f's push (recommended: yes).

units.title: Add .gitignore block for generated artifacts
units.intent: Append generated-artifact paths (system-graph.json etc.) to root .gitignore so they stop getting committed.

units.title: git rm --cached the now-ignored tracked artifacts
units.intent: Untrack the 118.76 MB system-graph.json blob and other ignored artifacts from the next tree, then commit.

units.title: Remove brave-euclid stray worktree + delete 14 worktree-agent-* cruft branches
units.intent: Remove the wrong-drive orphan worktree and prune the 14 merged auto-generated worktree-agent-* branches (doc id U-GC-06b, executes in P0).

units.title: git reflog expire + git gc --prune=now
units.intent: Reclaim ~41.5 GiB of loose-object garbage, shrinking .git from ~42 GB to ~3-5 GB without rewriting branches.

units.title: git config worktree.baseRef head + new trunk-guard.mjs SessionStart hook
units.intent: Set worktree.baseRef=head (doc id U-GC-05cfg) and create trunk-guard.mjs to detect HEAD not descending from the canonical trunk.

units.title: worktree-commit-route.mjs: [MAIN] bypasses worktree-routing only, never trunk-routing
units.intent: Add a trunk-ancestry check that runs before [MAIN]/[MAIN-FORCE] bypasses, warn-first then block.

units.title: Reconcile stale doctrine + point /sync-rebase at the canonical trunk
units.intent: Fix outdated CLAUDE.md/GSD docs, dangling refs, the git-stash instruction, and /sync-rebase's --base default.

units.title: History rewrite: strip generated blobs via filter-repo on a fresh mirror
units.intent: Mirror-backup then run git filter-repo to remove >100 MB system-graph.json blobs so cad-f can finally push.

units.title: Force-push the rewritten history; re-sync every worktree
units.intent: Force-push the rewrite to origin and reset --hard all ~40 worktrees to the new history.

units.title: Characterize main's 874 unique commits
units.intent: Analyze and classify main's unique work (superseded / salvageable / genuinely-unique) into MAIN-UNIQUE-WORK-AUDIT.md.

units.title: Reconcile main's unique work onto cad-f (staging branch) OR declare cad-f canonical
units.intent: Path A: cherry-pick/merge main's unique clusters via merge-staging branch; Path B: archive main and skip reconcile.

units.title: Promote the canonical trunk to main; retire the old trunks
units.intent: Rename canonical trunk to main, repoint origin/HEAD, retire/archive old trunks (cad-f, master, merge-staging).

units.title: Sweep all 40 worktrees for uncommitted WIP before P2's reset --hard
units.intent: Triage ~17k+ uncommitted lines across worktrees (commit/discard/archive) so the force-push doesn't destroy WIP.

units.title: Retire the broken work/xproc-neural worktree
units.intent: Remove the 0-commit broken xproc-neural worktree and its 13,119 untracked files after WIP triage.

units.title: Retire the stale-merged worktrees/branches
units.intent: Remove worktrees/branches fully absorbed into the canonical trunk (cost-cascade, graph-context, sfc-calibrate, etc.).

units.title: Triage the ~24 stale-unmerged work-branch forks
units.intent: User triages each abandoned milestone fork (revive / merge / archive-and-retire) into STALE-FORK-TRIAGE.md.

units.title: Retire worktree-u-fus-api01/02
units.intent: Triage WIP then remove the two idle auto-named fus-api worktrees, folding api01's 497 commits into U-GC-17.

units.title: Clean the claude/* auto-branches + origin/archive-2026-02-01 + origin/worktree-data-loss-fix
units.intent: Review and archive-and-retire stale Claude-Code auto-generated branches and old remote-only branches.

units.title: Decide on archive/forge-orphans-2026-05-01 (the 3.09 GB whisper model)
units.intent: Execute the U-GC-01 decision: keep the 3.3 GB archive branch or confirm recoverability and delete it.

units.title: Post-cleanup verification suite
units.intent: Run git fsck/count-objects/push-dry-run + hook checks to verify the remediated repo (.git <2 GiB, pushable).

units.title: Document the new topology + update memory + CLAUDE.md
units.intent: Write GIT-TOPOLOGY.md, update CLAUDE.md/memory, mark the milestone complete, schedule backup-mirror deletion.
